supported_ubuntu.note: Ubuntu LTS releases on which Docker Engine and the NVIDIA toolkit are installed from their apt repositories (Linux host, and the Sprut distribution on Windows). Anything else is UNSUPPORTED_PROFILE. Provisional: the accepted releases are fixed at S-1.

placeholders.name: system32
placeholders.description: Windows system directory from the OS API (GetSystemDirectoryW), never from PATH or an environment variable; only as the prefix of argv[0].

placeholders.name: distro_name
placeholders.description: Name of the Sprut WSL distribution, a client constant (working name sprut).

placeholders.name: distro_base_path
placeholders.description: Install directory of the Sprut distribution under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Sprut\wsl\, a client constant.

placeholders.name: verified_file
placeholders.description: Path of the copy made and checked by the preceding verify_source: owned by the principal that runs the command (root / the elevated helper), in a directory only that principal can write, its SHA-256 equal to step.source.sha256. Commands never use the downloaded file itself.

placeholders.name: codename
placeholders.description: Ubuntu codename of the target system, one of supported_ubuntu.codenames.

description.ru: SHA-256 проверенной копии (downloaded_sha256), вычисленный процессом, который её использует (для шагов с правами — сам elevated helper/процесс под sudo, в дистрибутиве Sprut — root внутри него), равен step.source.sha256. Если копию проверяет root внутри дистрибутива Sprut (Windows, {verified_file} использует Linux-программа), клиент до передачи файла в дистрибутив сам вычисляет SHA-256 загруженного файла (staged_sha256), и он тоже обязан быть равен step.source.sha256: совпасть должны оба значения (SEC-12). Шаг без source допустим только для kind с необязательным source (загрузку выполняет wsl.exe, это указано в заголовке).
description.en: The SHA-256 of the verified copy (downloaded_sha256), computed by the process that uses it (for privileged steps the elevated helper / the sudo process itself, in the Sprut distribution root inside it), equals step.source.sha256. When the copy is verified by root inside the Sprut distribution (Windows, {verified_file} is used by a Linux program), the client also computes the SHA-256 of the staged download itself before handing the file to the distribution (staged_sha256), and it must equal step.source.sha256 as well: both values must match (SEC-12). A step without source is allowed only for kinds whose source is optional (wsl.exe downloads; the title says so).

description.ru: Кодовое имя Ubuntu есть в supported_ubuntu.codenames, архитектура — supported_ubuntu.architecture.
description.en: The Ubuntu codename is in supported_ubuntu.codenames and the architecture equals supported_ubuntu.architecture.

description.ru: Пользователь процесса клиента ({name, uid} по uid процесса, не из переменных окружения) равен step.target_user.
description.en: The user of the client process ({name, uid} from the process uid, never from environment variables) equals step.target_user.

description.ru: Дистрибутив, зарегистрированный под step.distro.name, перечитан перед вызовом и его BasePath равен step.distro.base_path (иначе FOREIGN_RESOURCE); если он не зарегистрирован — PLAN_STALE.
description.en: The distribution registered under step.distro.name is re-read before the call and its BasePath equals step.distro.base_path (otherwise FOREIGN_RESOURCE); if it is not registered, PLAN_STALE.

description.ru: SHA-256 текущего .wslconfig (или absent) равен step.wslconfig_file.sha256: файл не менялся после показа плана.
description.en: The SHA-256 of the current .wslconfig (or absent) equals step.wslconfig_file.sha256: the file did not change since the plan was shown.

description.ru: Шаг останавливает все дистрибутивы WSL. restart_wsl: список запущенных дистрибутивов WSL прочитан (running_distributions — массив имён), задачи Sprut завершены (drain), и непосредственно перед перезапуском пользователь отдельно подтвердил его в диалоге, показывающем этот список (CR04). install_wsl и update_wsl (SEC-5: установка пакета WSL и wsl --update могут остановить все запущенные дистрибутивы): список зарегистрированных дистрибутивов прочитан (registered_distributions — массив имён); если у текущего пользователя нет ни одного зарегистрированного дистрибутива, условие выполнено без диалога (регистрации других пользователей компьютера клиенту не видны; что происходит с их дистрибутивами — проверка S-1); иначе нужны drain и такое же отдельное подтверждение в диалоге, показывающем зарегистрированные дистрибутивы. Список, который не удалось прочитать (факт отсутствует или не массив), — отказ (fail closed). Согласие с планом это подтверждение не заменяет.
description.en: The step stops all WSL distributions. restart_wsl: the list of running WSL distributions was read (running_distributions is an array of names), Sprut tasks were drained, and right before the restart the user separately confirmed it in a dialog that shows that list (CR04). install_wsl and update_wsl (SEC-5: installing the WSL package and wsl --update can stop every running distribution): the list of registered distributions was read (registered_distributions is an array of names); when the current user has no registered distribution the precondition holds without a dialog (registrations of other users of the computer are not visible to the client; what happens to their distributions is an S-1 check); otherwise the drain and the same separate confirmation are needed, in a dialog that shows the registered distributions. A list that could not be read (the fact is missing or not an array) fails closed. Plan consent does not replace this confirmation.

description.ru: Шаг останавливает дистрибутив Sprut (wsl --terminate, wsl --unregister) или останавливает либо перезапускает Docker Engine (systemctl stop/restart docker.service): задачи Sprut завершены (drain: приём задач прекращён, задачи завершены или остановлены по политике, освобождение ресурсов подтверждено). Пока это не так, шаг не выполняется (CR-49, CR-72).
description.en: The step stops the Sprut distribution (wsl --terminate, wsl --unregister) or stops or restarts Docker Engine (systemctl stop/restart docker.service): Sprut tasks were drained (no new tasks accepted, tasks finished or stopped per policy, the release of resources confirmed). Until then the step is not run (CR-49, CR-72).

description.ru: До удаления дистрибутива источник парного шага import_distro (следующий шаг согласованного плана) уже загружен и проверен: SHA-256 его проверенной копии (replacement_downloaded_sha256) равен source.sha256 этого следующего шага. Копии нет (загрузка не удалась, факт отсутствует, следующий шаг — не import_distro с source) — SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE; хеш другой — INTEGRITY_MISMATCH. В обоих случаях ничего не удаляется. Проверенная копия хранится до завершения импорта, и import_distro использует именно её (SEC-1).
description.en: Before the distribution is removed, the source of the paired import_distro step (the next step of the consented plan) is already downloaded and verified: the SHA-256 of its verified copy (replacement_downloaded_sha256) equals source.sha256 of that next step. No copy (the download failed, the fact is missing, the next step is not an import_distro with a source) is SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE; another hash is INTEGRITY_MISMATCH. In both cases nothing is removed. The verified copy is kept until the import ends, and import_distro uses exactly that copy (SEC-1).

title.ru: Включить компонент Windows «Подсистема Windows для Linux»
title.en: Enable the Windows feature Windows Subsystem for Linux

step_kinds.note: CW03. Run by the elevated helper.

title.en: Enable the Windows feature Virtual Machine Platform

step_kinds.note: CW03. Run by the elevated helper.

title.ru: Установить WSL из официального источника (запущенные дистрибутивы WSL могут быть остановлены)
title.en: Install WSL from the official source (running WSL distributions may be stopped)

title_without_source.ru: Установить WSL средствами wsl.exe (загрузку выполняет wsl.exe, Sprut не проверяет её хеш; запущенные дистрибутивы WSL могут быть остановлены)
title_without_source.en: Install WSL with wsl.exe (wsl.exe downloads it; Sprut does not verify its hash; running WSL distributions may be stopped)

step_kinds.note: CW03. With source: the client's pinned package, verified by the elevated helper. Without source: wsl.exe downloads, unverified by Sprut, and the title says so. The path is fixed at S-1; source prefix, redirect_hosts (the GitHub release-asset CDN hosts) and the download limits provisional, to confirm at S-1. download.timeout_seconds is the total time of the download for now; S-1 decision: a stall timeout with a generous total, or resume. SEC-5: installing the WSL package can stop every running WSL distribution, so the step needs the separate confirmation wsl_restart_confirmed whenever a distribution is registered; the real-host behaviour is an S-1 check. requires_reboot is `may`: the planner's forecast; the elevated helper's result carries reboot_required, the fact (docs/installation-plan.md section 9).

title.ru: Обновить WSL (запущенные дистрибутивы WSL могут быть остановлены)
title.en: Update WSL (running WSL distributions may be stopped)

title_without_source.ru: Обновить WSL средствами wsl.exe (загрузку выполняет wsl.exe, Sprut не проверяет её хеш; запущенные дистрибутивы WSL могут быть остановлены)
title_without_source.en: Update WSL with wsl.exe (wsl.exe downloads it; Sprut does not verify its hash; running WSL distributions may be stopped)

step_kinds.note: CW03. Separate plan step for WSL_OUTDATED; source, redirect_hosts and reboot as for install_wsl. SEC-5: wsl --update and the WSL package can stop every running WSL distribution, so the step needs the separate confirmation wsl_restart_confirmed whenever a distribution is registered; verifying on a real host which distributions wsl --update stops is an S-1 check.

title.ru: Удалить повреждённый дистрибутив WSL Sprut (данные внутри него будут потеряны)
title.en: Remove the damaged Sprut WSL distribution (data inside it will be lost)

step_kinds.note: CW04. Only the Sprut distribution, verified by its BasePath; needs the separate distro_removal acknowledgement; immediately followed by import_distro. Before it runs, Sprut tasks are drained and the source of that import_distro is already downloaded and verified (replacement_source_verified, SEC-1); otherwise nothing is removed. An export/backup option before removal is planned.

title.ru: Создать дистрибутив WSL Sprut из образа Ubuntu
title.en: Create the Sprut WSL distribution from the Ubuntu image

step_kinds.note: CW04. Pinned Ubuntu LTS rootfs, source.sha256 = SHA-256 of the archive. Source prefixes and download limits provisional, to confirm at S-1 (Q10). download.timeout_seconds is the total time of the download for now; S-1 decision: a stall timeout with a generous total, or resume (a slow connection must not make the rootfs unreachable). After unregister_distro the step uses the copy that was verified before the removal; it is re-hashed (source_verified), never downloaded again.

title.ru: Включить systemd в дистрибутиве Sprut (дистрибутив Sprut будет остановлен; его задачи сначала завершаются)
title.en: Enable systemd in the Sprut distribution (the Sprut distribution is stopped; its tasks are drained first)

step_kinds.note: CW05. Restarts only the Sprut distribution (wsl --terminate), after a drain of Sprut tasks (sprut_drained, CR-49).

title.en: Add the official Docker apt repository

step_kinds.note: Spec 7.4 item 2, CW05. source = repository signing key; the key is trusted only for this repository (signed-by), never added to the global trust store. Source prefix provisional, to confirm at S-1. apt-get update runs with APT::Update::Error-Mode=any, so that an index that cannot be fetched or verified gives a non-zero exit status (by default apt-get update exits 0 with warnings); the option is to be confirmed on jammy at S-1. The update covers every configured source, because the Docker packages depend on packages of the Ubuntu archive whose indexes must be present and current; on a Linux host a foreign source that cannot be fetched therefore fails the step (SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE) and is never edited or disabled by Sprut.

Spec 7.4 item 2, CW05. Package versions are those of the repository at run time (apt verifies them with the scoped key). Conflicting packages are never removed automatically (ACTION_REQUIRED). dockerd listens only on its unix socket: no daemon.json hosts entry with tcp://, no -H tcp:// (checked in ENGINE_CHECK).

title.ru: Добавить пользователя в группу docker (равносильно правам root)
title.en: Add the user to the docker group (equivalent to root access)

step_kinds.note: Spec 7.4 item 3. Never silently: separate docker_group acknowledgement; a new login is required afterwards (RELOGIN_REQUIRED, exit code 5).

title.ru: Установить NVIDIA Container Toolkit (Docker Engine будет перезапущен: все контейнеры на этом компьютере будут остановлены)
title.en: Install the NVIDIA Container Toolkit (Docker Engine is restarted: all containers on this computer are stopped)

title.ru: Установить NVIDIA Container Toolkit (Docker Engine в дистрибутиве Sprut будет перезапущен; его задачи сначала завершаются)
title.en: Install the NVIDIA Container Toolkit (Docker Engine in the Sprut distribution is restarted; its tasks are drained first)

step_kinds.note: Spec 7.4 item 1, CW09. Optional, by separate consent; source = repository signing key, scoped with signed-by. The NVIDIA driver is never installed or replaced. Source prefix provisional, to confirm at S-1. The step restarts docker.service, which stops every container of that engine: it runs only after a drain of Sprut tasks (sprut_drained). On Linux the engine is the host's, so containers that are not Sprut's stop too: the Linux title says so and the step needs the separate engine_restart acknowledgement (CLI --accept-engine-restart). Replacing the restart by a configuration reload is an S-1 investigation.

title.ru: Запустить Docker Engine и включить его автозапуск
title.en: Start Docker Engine and enable it at boot

title.ru: Изменить ресурсы WSL в .wslconfig (действует на все дистрибутивы WSL)
title.en: Change WSL resources in .wslconfig (affects all WSL distributions)

step_kinds.note: CR01-CR04. Only the managed [wsl2] keys, with backup and atomic write; wslconfig_file binds the file state shown to the user (CR03).

title.ru: Изменить максимальный размер диска дистрибутива Sprut (дистрибутив Sprut будет остановлен; его задачи сначала завершаются)
title.en: Change the maximum disk size of the Sprut distribution (the Sprut distribution is stopped; its tasks are drained first)

step_kinds.note: CR01, CR02. Sprut distribution only; never .wslconfig defaultVhdSize. wsl --manage --resize needs a stopped distribution: the template terminates the Sprut distribution first, after a drain of Sprut tasks (sprut_drained, CR-49).

CR04. A separate confirmed action at execution time (precondition wsl_restart_confirmed), after a drain. The dialog lists the running WSL distributions; if that list cannot be read, the step is not run (fail closed).
Pull by ImageReference in the IMAGE_PULL state (guards image_allowlisted, image_in_consented_plan), not in INSTALLING.
